convertibility_reason: Uses external custom signal library CBE_BE_RSI from MySignals .mqh, which contains the core trading logic. The signal filter class and its entry/exit logic must be manually inspected and translated since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator.

other_exits: Signal threshold close at 20 - CExpertSignal closes position when reverse signal strength exceeds Signal_ThresholdClose

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size; Percent parameter is used as free margin percent for lot calculation in standard MQL5 Expert library

custom_logic_notes: The core entry/exit logic resides in CBE_BE_RSI class (ACBE_BE_RSI.mqh) which is a custom signal filter. The signal likely uses RSI(11) with MA(5) smoothing to generate weighted buy/sell signals. CExpertSignal uses threshold-based voting: open when signal strength >= 40, close when reverse signal strength >= 20. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA processes only on new bar completion, not every tick.
python_conversion_notes: Must read and translate CBE_BE_RSI class from ACBE_BE_RSI.mqh to understand the exact signal generation logic (RSI+MA crossover/crossunder or level-based). The MQL5 CExpertSignal framework uses a weighted voting system with open/close thresholds that must be replicated. Position sizing uses CMoneyFixedLot which combines fixed lots with a percent-of-margin fallback. No digit adjustment needed since SL/TP are both 0. New-bar guard is implicit via Expert_EveryTick=false.
